>
[Ore Fists](/Feats.aspx?ID=4374) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 82

**Archetype** [Stone Brawler](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=209)

**Prerequisites**
[Stone Brawler Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4371)

</column>

---

When you enter the Stonestrike Stance, your fists appear to be covered with veins of unrefined ore. Your stonestrike attacks count as [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374) and [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379) when determining weaknesses and bypassing resistances.

<title level="2">Ore Fists leads to...</title>
[Adamantine Fists](/Feats.aspx?ID=4376)
